state: lowest qualified n_pi singlet from retained vertical checkpoints
response_policy: frozen calibration transported in the existing co-rotating local frame
orbital_solver: gmf; retain each component saddle index
final_hessian: analytic nuclear, independently relaxed components, arithmetic mean
stationary_gate: geometry converged, final analytic Hessian, no imaginary vibrational mode below -20 cm^-1; all state-following guards unchanged
stationary_verification: random normalized nuclear direction, central gradient differences at 0.0002 and 0.0001 bohr
negative_curvature_policy: report; at most two continuation branches along the most negative vibrational mode, +/- 0.02 angstrom RMS, without changing state identity or calibration
tda_control: own corrected GFN2 orbitals and the corresponding parent kernel; use completed vertical controls first, no DFT-orbital TDA substituted
accuracy_reference: primary literature S1 geometry/frequencies where identifiable; harmonic and experimental fundamental frequencies kept distinct; DFT reference calculations if needed labelled separately
timing: record wall times by phase and source; previously completed preparation reported separately, not treated as zero cost
checkpoint_policy: reuse existing vertical and derivative checkpoints; preserve accepted state bundles and optimizer resume artifacts; no restart of completed phases
